Health data privacy

If you enable body metrics, Lofit reads your weight from Health Connect when you start a workout. It uses the nearest measurements around the workout start time, taking their average when both exist. If only one measurement exists, it uses that weight.

When you finish a workout, Lofit reads heart rate samples during its training intervals and saves their average. Breaks between continued workout sessions are excluded. You can request delayed heart rate data from History; Lofit checks newest workouts first and stops at the first workout with a saved average.

Weight and average heart rate are saved with the workout on this device and shown in workout history. Lofit does not write health data, upload it, or share it with other apps.

Health history access lets Lofit use measurements older than 30 days. You can turn body metrics off in Lofit settings or revoke access in Health Connect at any time. This stops future reads. Saved workout health data remains until you clear app storage in Android settings or uninstall Lofit.
